Mind hi sab kuch—jaisa sochte ho, vaisa bante ho.
Ekmatra seema wo hai jo aap khud banate ho.
"Kuch nahi chalega—jab tak tum nahi karo."
Finish line nahi—sirf milestones.
Seekhte raho.
Main apni kismat ka master hoon.
"Success choti efforts ka sum hai—repeat."
Failure success ka hi raasta hai.

Jo tumhare paas hai, usse woh karo jo kar sakte ho.

"Success position se nahi, vision ki breadth se measure hoti."
Mindset sab kuch hai.
